entry.title: Amazon Tall Tower Observatory
entry.note: Exact-QID OSM tower node identifies the main structure, approximately 6 m from the published 2015 coordinate. Native (-X,+Z) corner has bearing 225 degrees before placement; heading 23 degrees produces the independently published lift-corner bearing 202 degrees. The foundation position, guy-anchor distances and ground heights require site validation. Study anchor radii 75/150/225 m are provisional; do not treat their blocks as surveyed. This asset currently covers the main tall tower. The two separate 80/81 m companion towers and laboratory compound remain required site work. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
